data.keyword: What's the best help desk software for a small support team?

result.keyword: What's the best help desk software for a small support team?
result.markdown:
For a small support team, I'd recommend **Freshdesk, Help Scout, or Zendesk**, depending on how you handle customer inquiries and how much automation you need.

You probably don't need an enterprise-grade platform with dozens of complicated features. The best help desk software should make it easy to\:

- Manage customer requests in one place.
- Assign tickets and track ownership.
- Avoid duplicate responses.
- Create canned replies and automate repetitive work.
- Measure response times and team performance.
- Scale as your support team grows.

- Strong ticket management.

Best if your team primarily handles customer support through email. [Visit Help Scout](https://www.helpscout.com/)\.

- Website live chat.
- AI-powered customer support.
- Automated responses.
- In-app messaging.

Best for SaaS companies and businesses with chat-heavy support. [Visit Intercom](https://www.intercom.com/)\.

## My recommendation

For most small support teams, I'd shortlist these three\:

| Your priority | My pick |
|--------|--------|
| Best overall functionality | Freshdesk |
| Simplicity and ease of use | Help Scout |
| Advanced features and scalability | Zendesk |


I wouldn't automatically choose Zendesk just because it's well-known. A smaller team can often get everything it needs from Freshdesk or Help Scout at a lower cost.
